description: This file defines the TransactionService class, which manages financial transactions such as fund transfers and utility payments within an online banking system. It includes methods for fund transfer, utility payments, balance validation, and internal transfer logic, utilizing repositories and account services for database operations and business logic.

classes.name: TransactionService
classes.description: Service layer component that handles core banking transactions such as fund transfers and utility payments, enforcing business rules and persisting transaction records.

methods.name: fundTransfer
methods.description: Performs a fund transfer between two bank accounts after validating sufficient balance and returns a response with transaction details.

methods.name: utilPayment
methods.description: Processes a utility payment, validates funds, updates account balances, and records the transaction.

methods.name: validateBalance
methods.description: Checks if the account has adequate funds for the transaction, throws InsufficientFundsException if not.

methods.name: internalFundTransfer
methods.description: Handles the transfer of funds between accounts, updates balances, and logs the transaction, returning the transaction ID.
